name: DexCleaner cleanup manifest
policy: Exact canonical allowlist only. Safe entries may be moved to Finder Trash after preview. Caution, Audit only, Forbidden, and Protected entries are visible for audit but never selectable.

safeExactTargets.explanation: Homebrew download and build cache. Regeneratable by Homebrew.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: Homebrew will download packages again when needed.

safeExactTargets.explanation: pip wheel and HTTP cache. Regeneratable.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: pip will re-download packages when needed.
SwiftPM will resolve and fetch packages again.

safeExactTargets.explanation: npm package tarball and metadata cache. Regeneratable.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: npm will re-download packages when needed.

safeExactTargets.explanation: pnpm cache under the macOS cache directory. Regeneratable.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: pnpm will re-download packages when needed.

safeExactTargets.explanation: Yarn package cache under the macOS cache directory. Regeneratable.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: Yarn will re-download packages when needed.
CocoaPods will download pods again when needed.

safeExactTargets.explanation: Gradle cache under the macOS cache directory. Regeneratable.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: Gradle will download dependencies again when needed.

safeExactTargets.explanation: Xcode cache under the macOS cache directory. Regeneratable.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: Xcode will rebuild cache data when needed.

safeExactTargets.explanation: Xcode module cache inside DerivedData. Regeneratable compiler cache.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: Xcode will rebuild module cache data during future builds.

safeExactTargets.explanation: CoreSimulator cache directory. Regeneratable by Simulator and Xcode.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: Simulator and Xcode will recreate cache data when needed.

safeExactTargets.explanation: VS Code runtime cache only, not workspace or global state.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: VS Code will regenerate runtime cache after launch.

safeExactTargets.explanation: Large Xcode build artifacts. Visible for review but not selected automatically.
safeExactTargets.recoveryNote: Xcode can rebuild this, but rebuilds may be slow.
Manage local copies through the cloud provider or Finder manually.
